# Post-review R2 controls, 2026-11-10
All questions selected after R2 TEST and Claude review; exploratory, no revised primary decisions. Reuse exact frozen 200 CAL / 658 TEST participants, 49 endpoints and CAL prior denominators. No GPU, new people, A17 or external registration.
C1: mix decoder1200 with FIT1000 Laplace prior, uniform, and a new FIT1000 exact-stimulus-cell empirical prior (Laplace alpha=1 per category; missing cell fallback to FIT endpoint prior). Each uses the unchanged 0:.1:1 grid, endpoint CAL proper loss, smallest-weight tie. Report every control and a library control choosing the best control+weight on CAL (33 candidates, explicitly three times the grid size). No TEST selection. Three controls require no refitting learned models. This is not a substitute for every non-selected learned family.
C2: Granite-neutral and T0 person-invariant proxy: average their saved CAL forecasts within identical canonical endpoint + exact rendered stimulus (product/price and options); endpoint average fallback. CAL proxy is leave-one-person-out; TEST proxy uses CAL only. No TEST forecast/outcome enters proxy construction. Record fallback counts; this is an aggregation proxy, not a deranged-history intervention. Mix each with decoder1200 under the same CAL grid and compare paired personalized vs proxy mixture.
C4: report absolute normalized loss and native economic logloss / ordinal RPS / nonordinal-other logloss separately. Report prior-relative gains descriptively, no new practical margin.
C8: 2000 paired bootstrap replicates with CAL resampled jointly across endpoints, reselect original Granite neutral/T0 weights (decoder/LLM fixed), independently resample TEST participants jointly across endpoints; condition on fixed FIT/prior-normalization. Seed 20261111. Additionally report standard 10000 TEST-only paired intervals seed20261110 for all specified contrasts. No significance promotion or p-value fishing; no Holm success claim.
Comparisons: both original Granite CAL mixtures vs each of three controls and CAL-selected library, each vs matching person-invariant mixture, plus direct T0-neutral under CAL reselection. Include original own-decoder and Full1400 contrasts and all weight histograms. Preserve outcomes of every comparison.
Checks: original original-weight CAL selections reproduce frozen weights exactly; selected TEST losses reproduce saved mixture forecasts to1e-12; source auditor/official gate/normalization hashes unchanged; finite arrays and complete panel. Individual matrices/proxy forecasts stay on Euler. Export aggregate JSON and source/Slurm receipts only.
Finite Slurm infer 4 CPUs 24GB 00:20:00. Engineering failure is not a scientific negative; preserve failed receipt before any fix.
